Claude 2.1.329 permission evidence, retrieved 2026-11-21.
https://code.claude.com/docs/en/permissions
Summary: dontAsk denies unapproved operations. Edit path rules cover Write too;
Write(path) rules do not match. Double-slash paths anchor at the filesystem root.
Bare tool rules match all uses; Bash rules without wildcards match exact commands.
Wildcards broaden matching. Native compound matching belongs to Claude.
Additional directories extend file access. Permissions are not an OS sandbox.
https://code.claude.com/docs/en/cli-reference
TF-C1: installed help lists acceptEdits, auto, bypassPermissions, manual, dontAsk, plan.
TF-C2: help lists allowedTools and add-dir; acceptEdits is not a general Bash grant.
TF-C3: help lists permission-prompts none; noninteractive does not grant tools.
Installed help documents restricted ignoring inherited settings while applying
--settings and limiting file tools to working directories plus --add-dir.
Live envelopes corroborate permission_denials, explicit edit approval, method-root
denial, git commit denial and the compound command under one exact Bash rule.
Claude 2.1.332 readonly.json, recaptured 2026-11-27: the exact review_diff command
on a non-empty two-commit range runs under its one exact Bash allow rule and
returns the whole patch.
Claude 2.1.332 large-diff.json, captured 2026-11-27: a review diff past Bash's
